pages.text: Presses $(l)organic waste$() into $(l)Biomass$(), the solid mash a $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l) turns into Biogas. It runs on $(l)8 FE/t$() and needs a $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Cyber Frame Block$(/l) above it: with one there it assembles into a press two blocks tall, and only then works. It takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI.

$(li)Accepts $(l)anything a composter takes$() (seeds, crops, leaves, saplings, flowers...) and $(l)rotten flesh$(). A hopper feeds it through the funnel on top, or from the sides of its lower block.$(br)$(li)The mash in its chamber rises with what is inside, up to a full stack.

$(li)$(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l) connect to the machine block. Without power it waits and keeps its progress.$(br)$(li)Each item takes 2 seconds and gives a $(item)Biomass$() with the chance a composter would take it: a cake always gives one, a seed only sometimes, and rotten flesh 4 times out of 5.

$(li)The $(l)nozzle on its right$(), as you face its open front, pushes the Biomass into the container there: a hopper, a chest or a Bio-Digester. A hopper under the press or a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport$(/l) drone can take it too; they take only the Biomass, never the waste still to press.

Biomass is also a $(l)weak fertilizer$(): use it on a plant by hand or load it in a dock for a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Fertilizer$(/l) drone. It is always used up, but grows the plant only one time in three, so bone meal goes further and Biogas stays a real alternative.
